[D8:10] Gina: Thanks! So far, so good - customers love the new offers and promotions, which means I'm seeing more sales. People seem to really like my designs, so I'm always on the hunt for unique, trendy pieces. Growing my customer base is the main focus right now.
[D8:11] Jon: Sounds like all your effort's paying off. Anything planned to grow your customer base?
[D8:12] Gina: Yeah, I have a few plans. I'm thinking of working with some fashion bloggers and influencers in the next few months to get more attention for my store. Plus, I'm going to do more ads so I can reach more people. I'm really focused on building my customer base and making my store a top destination for fashion fans. It's awesome to see it all coming together! You, Jon? What do you have going for your dance studio?

I'm also hosting a dance competition next month to showcase local talent and bring more attention to my studio. All the work's paying off - I'm seeing progress and the dancers are so excited. It's such a great feeling to give a place where people can express themselves through dance!
[D8:14] Gina: Wow! That's fantastic that your studio's expanding and giving dancers an outlet. So proud of the progress you've made - keep it up!
[D8:15] Jon: Thanks! Your backing means a lot. I'm trying to make my plan work, even though it's been tough. Your encouragement really helps. Are you coming to the event next month? Love to have you there!
[D8:15] Image caption (automatic): a photo of a group of people on a stage with a projector screen

[D8:18] Gina: Sounds great! I'm definitely in for the show.

[D8:19] Jon: Cool! Can't wait to see you!
[D8:19] Image caption (automatic): a photo of two women doing a handstand in a room
[D8:20] Gina: Thanks, Jon! See you at the event!
[D8:20] Image caption (automatic): a photo of a group of young girls in tutuss and ballet shoes
[D8:21] Jon: Gina, good luck with your store!
[D8:21] Image caption (automatic): a photo of a dress with a sign on it that says june bunty
[D8:22] Gina: Thanks, Jon! Appreciate the kind words. <3

[D8:23] Image caption (automatic): a photo of a street light on a sidewalk in front of a building

Session date: 10:33 am on 9 April, 2023
[D9:1] Jon: Hey Gina! I'm turning my loves of dance into a business. I'm sunk tons of time into the studio lately, and look at my students - they're already killing it. I'm even learning with them!
[D9:1] Image caption (automatic): a photo of a group of dancers on a stage with a red background
[D9:2] Gina: Hey Jon! Wow, way to take your passion and make it into a biz! The dance studio looks awesome.
[D9:2] Image caption (automatic): a photo of a display of a dress and a flamingo
[D9:3] Jon: Thanks, Gina! I'm determined to make this studio work. Losing my job was tough but it gave me the push I needed to do what I love.
[D9:4] Gina: Woah, Jon! Tough times can be a gateway to awesome things. Glad you worked up the courage to go after your dreams!
[D9:4] Image caption (automatic): a photo of a red dress with gold accents on a mannequin
[D9:5] Jon: Yeah, Gina! It's been tough, but I'm living my true self. Dancing makes me so happy, and now I get to share that with other people. Seeing my students get better at it brings me such joy.
[D9:5] Image caption (automatic): a photo of a woman doing a pole dance in a dance studio
[D9:6] Gina: Wow Jon, you look so happy when you dance! Show the world your true self and keep dancing!
[D9:7] Jon: Thanks a bunch, Gina! You seriously rock. Dancing for me is like a way to express myself and find my happy place. I used to be scared to death of what people would think, but I learnt that my own happiness is the most important thing. It's been tough but also the best thing ever!
[D9:8] Gina: Yeah, I do remember those dance classes! I used to love spending time in the studio. That photo looks awesome, brings back lots of memories. It's nice to know, dance is still your happy place.
[D9:8] Image caption (automatic): a photo of a group of young women in ballet attire
[D9:9] Jon: Nice, Gina! I'm happy that dance has such a special meaning to both of us. It's a really cool way to express ourselves. I loved taking lessons with my friends when I was younger. Those memories are so precious. So glad I can still enjoy it with my own studio. Thanks for always being there for me.
[D9:10] Gina: Hey Jon! Got your back - dance is awesome for expressing yourself and finding happiness. Here's one of my trophies from a dance contest, nice reminder of the hard work, dedication and joy it brings.
[D9:10] Image caption (automatic): a photo of a trophy with a glass globe on top
[D9:11] Jon: Wow! It looks awesome! Thanks for the support, it really means a lot.
[D9:12] Gina: No prob, Jon! You earned all the kudos for your hard work. Keep it up!
[D9:13] Jon: Thanks! Gonna keep pushing and working hard. Won't let anything hold me back!
[D9:14] Gina: Way to go, Jon! Keep it up, you're almost there!
Session date: 11:24 am on 25 April, 2023
[D10:1] Jon: Hi Gina! I just wanted to fill you in on my business. Yesterday, I went to a fair to show off my studio, it was both stressful and great! I got some possible leads, so that was awesome. But overall, I've learned that this biz is no cakewalk and having confidence in yourself is important for making it successful!
[D10:1] Image caption (automatic): a photo of a group of women performing a dance on a stage
[D10:2] Gina: Hey Jon, congrats on the fair! It's awesome to see your hard work paying off. Keep on pushing, pal, you're headed for greatness. Oh, and BTW, I started my own online clothing store not so long ago - pretty cool, huh?
[D10:2] Image caption (automatic): a photography of a laptop with a sale ad on the screen
[D10:3] Jon: Thanks, Gina! Appreciate your support. Your store looks great, I remember it!
[D10:4] Gina: Thanks, Jon! After losing my job, I wanted to take control of my own destiny and this seemed like the perfect way to do it. It's been a tough journey, but very rewarding.
[D10:5] Jon: Wow, you're awesome for going for it! Setbacks can help us reach our potential, right? I'm having trouble with my business project. Any advice on staying motivated even when times are tough?
[D10:6] Gina: Yeah Jon! Challenges are awesome for learning and growth. To stay motivated, I think of the big goal and why I'm doing it. I also get help from people who support me. And of course, I dance it out. Do you need advice on anything in particular?
[D10:7] Jon: I've been feeling kinda low on confidence lately. It's hard to run a business when you don't have faith in yourself. Any tips on how you stay confident in your business?
